quarterly_data.quarter: Montage Technology half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2026 half-year report: net profit excluding non-recurring items was RMB 13.22 hundred million, up 21.2%, against reported net profit of RMB 19.97 hundred million, up 72.3%; gross profit RMB 21.79 hundred million, up 36.9%. Investment income plus fair-value gains totalled RMB 6.82 hundred million (up 5,939.4%), including RMB 4.56 hundred million of gains on the sale of its 13.075% stake in XConn Technologies, which Marvell acquired, and on selling the Marvell shares received as part of the consideration; an RMB 1.74 hundred million foreign-exchange loss on foreign-currency assets (mainly H-share proceeds) weighed on profit. Jintide product line revenue RMB 2.20 hundred million, up 31.2%. Q2 2026 net profit RMB 11.50 hundred million, up 81.5% year over year and 35.7% quarter over quarter. H1 operating cash flow RMB 13.28 hundred million, up 25.4%.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 2026 net profit ex-items RMB 13.22 hundred million (+21.2%); investment and fair-value gains RMB 6.82 hundred million; Q2 net profit RMB 11.50 hundred million (+81.5% YoY)

quarterly_data.quarter: Montage Technology half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2026 half-year report: on July 15, 2026 the Fair Trade Investigation Division of the Seoul Central District Prosecutors' Office searched the company's Korea office over potential antitrust violations. The company says it is fully cooperating, neither it nor its directors or employees have been charged with any wrongdoing, operations are normal, and it cannot predict the timing or outcome of the investigation.

quarterly_data.quarter: Montage Technology half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2026 half-year report: inventory book value was RMB 9.96 hundred million at June 30, 2026; long-term prepaid expenses rose 56.18%, mainly on more photomask sets for mass-production chips. 604 R&D staff (74.11% of headcount); 233 invention patents granted in total. Construction in progress: the Lingang R&D centre project in Shanghai (budget RMB 797,460,000.00) reached RMB 708,863,966.38, 88.89% of budget, still under construction. The report adds that leading cloud providers and server OEM/ODM makers have launched test prototypes with CXL memory-pooling solutions, so CXL MXC chips and related solutions have entered industry trial and validation.
quarterly_data.figure: Inventory RMB 9.96 hundred million; Lingang R&D centre 88.89% of budget
